_comment: Pinned llama.cpp release. Fetched by scripts/fetch-llama-binaries.js into resources/<platform>-<arch>/llama-server/ and bundled into the packaged app by forge.config.js. To bump: pick a newer tag from https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases, update `size` from that release's asset metadata, then re-run `node scripts/fetch-llama-binaries.js`.
